    Install

    1. Tap the button and let the download finish.
    2. Open the file. If Android asks, allow your browser to install unknown apps, then go back and tap Install.
    3. If Google Play Protect says "App scan recommended", tap More details, then "Install without scanning". Scan app would send the file to Google.
    4. On Android 13 or newer (Samsung especially), if making it your SMS app says "App was denied access": open Settings › Apps › SMS Messenger, tap ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then try again in the app.
    5. Updating? Install the new file over the old one, or let the app update itself. Your messages and settings stay.

    SMS Messenger keeps everything on your phone. Opening this page sends nothing about you. The app is signed with one key, so Android only accepts updates from the same source.
